provider: Copernicus DEM, distributed through AWS Open Data
dataset: GLO-90 DSM scenery, aligned to published F1 start/finish absolute datum; not bare-earth terrain
method: Existing retained DSM relative grid is uniformly shifted by old median datum minus factual F1 absolute minimum. No resampling, land mask, coastal blend, racing-road or native collision changes. Existing20m near-road join remains. This removes an incompatible median roof-biased datum; it does not make GLO-90 bare earth.
licence: Copernicus DEM open data licence; see retained scenery-terrain source attribution.
grid_frame_note: Retained grid XY uses this original geographic projection scale. Materialization composes current provenance scene scale into XY origin/spacing only; source heights and vertical datum remain unchanged.
